intent.proves: At least one display group with a name (on the group or translated into the default language) holds two or more fields.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomFieldDisplayGroups g WHERE (ISNULL(g.FieldDisplayGroupName, N'') <> N'' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomFieldDisplayGroupTranslation t WHERE (t.FieldDisplayGroupTranslationGroupId = g.FieldDisplayGroupId OR t.FieldDisplayGroupTranslationGroupSystemName = g.FieldDisplayGroupSystemName) AND t.FieldDisplayGroupTranslationLanguageId = N'{lang}' AND ISNULL(t.FieldDisplayGroupTranslationText, N'') <> N'')) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomFieldDisplayGroupFields f WHERE f.FieldDisplayGroupFieldGroupId = g.FieldDisplayGroupId) >= 2
